_note: Wild work done in person on the inner map (ui/mapTasks/wildTasks.js, systems/wildTasks.js): foraging, hunting, fishing, winter trapping and ice fishing, smuggling and pickpocketing. The rewards stay with the old handlers (player/foraging.js, player/seasonalWork.js, ui/actionMenu); this file holds the wording and the feel of each task. Radii are in inner-map tiles, times in real seconds unless named Hours. {name} style fields are filled in by the task.

prompt.inPersonHint: Do it in person on the map: the better you do, the better it goes.
prompt.quickHint: A plain day's result, no walking.

forage.title: Foraging
forage.say: Gather what you find. Marked patches are plain to see; search near cover to turn up the rest.
forage.nearby: You spot signs of something to the {dir}.
forage.empty: You searched but found nothing of value today.

hunt.title: Hunting
hunt.say: Follow the sign to the {name}. Creep up: walking near it alarms it, standing still calms it. Loose when you are close.
read: A tuft of fur on the thorns.
hunt.bolted: The {name} bolts! It runs a way off and stops, ears up.
hunt.gone: The {name} bolts into cover and is gone.

fish.title: Fishing
fish.say: Go down to the water and cast. When it bites, strike!
fish.quiet: Nothing biting… the water is quiet.
fish.snapped: The line snapped! The {name} got away.
fish.shy: The fish here have gone shy. Try along the bank.
fish.left: You reel in and walk off.

trap.title: Trapping
trap.runSay: Paw prints mark the game runs. Set your snares on the runs, under cover, then walk back round and check them.
trap.setSay: Lay a trap line: set the snares on the game runs, under cover. Where you set them decides what the line takes.
trap.tendSay: Walk your trap line from snare to snare. Only the snares you reach are emptied.
trap.tooClose: You already have a snare here.

setNote.good: A good spot: right on the run, with cover.
setNote.poor: Open ground: little will pass this way.

trap.set: Set a snare on the run
trap.allSet: The snares are set. Walk back round and check them.

iceFish.title: Ice Fishing
iceFish.shoreSay: Cut a hole near the bank and fish through it.
iceFish.farSay: Walk out to where the ice is thin, cut a hole and fish.
iceFish.cutShore: Cut a hole in the ice
iceFish.cutFar: Out on the thin ice: cut a hole

smuggle.title: Smuggling
smuggle.say: Carry the {item} to the fence's door. Keep out of the watch's sight.
smuggle.hand: Hand the goods to the fence
smuggle.seen: {name} of the watch is looking your way!

pickpocket.title: Pickpocket
pickpocket.say: Get close to the {name} and lift the purse while they're not looking. Step back when they turn round.
